title: How Prompt Style Affects AI Accuracy and Speed in Competitive Programming
abstract: arXiv:2610.30223v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models are increasingly used in competitive programming, and their outputs are sensitive to how a prompt is phrased. Prior work has compared prompt strategies for accuracy on competitive programming, but not for runtime speed, and has not situated the results against human performance. In an exploratory study of one prompt in each of nine styles on GPT-5.5 across three accuracy tasks from the International Olympiad in Informatics (IOI) and two NP-hard speed tasks, we found that no single prompt was best: the strongest prompt depended on the task type and on whether results were summarized by the mean or the median, suggesting that, at least for these tasks, prompt style should be matched to the objective rather than treated as universal. translated_title: 提示风格如何影响AI在竞技编程中的准确性与速度
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型越来越多地被用于竞技编程，其输出对提示的措辞方式十分敏感。已有研究比较了竞技编程中不同提示策略在准确性上的表现，但未比较运行速度，也没有将结果与人类表现进行对照。在一项探索性研究中，我们在GPT-5.5上对九种风格各选取一个提示进行测试，涵盖国际信息学奥林匹克竞赛（IOI）的三个准确性任务和两个NP难速度任务。我们发现不存在单一的最佳提示：最强的提示取决于任务类型，也取决于结果是用均值还是中位数来汇总，这表明至少对于这些任务，提示风格应当与目标相匹配，而不能被当作通用方案。许多均值分数上的差异来自少数离群运行，这说明仅用单一指标评估提示的效果，可能会掩盖其有效性的巨大波动。与（人类表现）进行的描述性比较（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究通过在IOI准确性任务与NP难速度任务上测试九种提示风格，发现没有普适最佳提示，提示风格的选择应取决于任务类型和统计汇总方式，且单一指标评估会掩盖提示效果的不稳定性。
en_tdlr: No single prompt style is universally best for competitive programming AI—the strongest prompt depends on task type and statistical aggregation method, so prompt style should be matched to the objective rather than treated as one-size-fits-all.
